score_causal_lm_labels: score items against a query using a CausalLM model with label token IDs and softmax
score_sequence_classification: score items using a SequenceClassification model returning pooled class logits
score_with_embed_overrides: score items with embedding overrides replacing placeholder tokens in query and items
async_score_items: async score items against a query using the loaded model without blocking the event loop
score_return_pooled_hidden_states: score items and return raw pooled transformer hidden states before the task head
